candidate: Direct attention masking does not imply goal-independent dynamics when contextualized input-action tokens carry goals across layers.
report_note_cn: WorldAgen 发布权重的 CPU 冻结短测已完成：固定 3 个 LIBERO 轨迹片段的图像、状态、动作和随机种子，只换目标指令，预测图像相对 L2 差异为 31.82%、29.40%、14.15%。原生掩码禁止目标直达图像预测，却允许目标经输入动作 token 间接传入；仅删除 9 条目标到动作 token 的连接后，换目标或空目标引起的预测差异全部为 0，而策略输出仍随目标变化。同输入重复完全一致，参数摘要前后相同。共 24 次原生前向、约 36.08 秒 CPU，无训练、环境步或 GPU。官方评测入口的夹爪维度不一致，本测明确采用模型支持的二值夹爪模式，未复现完整 LIBERO 评测；也未证明预测更准确、任务损害或论文级新意。
compatibility_limit: Unchanged native forward and exact released learned weights, but gripper_width=False rather than the incompatible released gripper_width=True evaluation wrapper. Encoders independently loaded from official verified weights. LeRobot state/image conversion is not byte-identical to author data.
meaning: Goal-to-input-action-to-world influence exists numerically in released weights. Cutting it restores conditional invariance in this probe, not accuracy or safety. Policy outputs are expected to remain goal-dependent.
security_limit: Native online policy does not consume its decoded world prediction in ordinary action inference. No harmful action, TTT update, persistence, or benchmark return has been established.
novelty_limit: Instruction Leakage and a Goal-Free Dynamics Fix already establishes generic goal leakage and goal-free dynamics. This direct-mask failure is a bounded architecture/implementation finding, not by itself a broad 7–7.5 novelty mechanism.
next_requirement: Treat indirect goal influence as a bounded released-weight counterexample, not the main research claim. Generic instruction leakage already has direct prior art. A further security mechanism must establish substantive novelty, a reproducible competent native controller, attacker permissions, and causal task harm before scale-up; do not silently substitute a custom planner or treat mask reachability as success.
rejected_adjacent_path: JEPA-TTT updates from executed actions and real observations, not arbitrary prediction queries. Its persistent optimizer does not supply a new query-only operation; optimizer-state transfer also has direct prior art.
